main_body: A roofed well or stall: a blue-grey slatted roof on two wooden posts, with a stone-rimmed water basin at the front
top_band: Roof: row 1 light blue-grey (L158), row 2 L130, then a dark line at row 3 and slatted slope rows 4-15 in L130 to L104. Basin: rim row 30 (L185), water rows 31-34 (blue), front lip row 35.
evidence: The roof reads as a sloped surface with a lit ridge and a dark hem and eave shadow at rows 15-17, like the reference well roof. The basin shows a light rim (row 30), about 4 rows of water seen from above (rows 31-34) and a front lip at row 35. Below that is a gray front face of rows 36-42 (about 7 rows). The posts are vertical supports with open space behind them, so both major parts satisfy the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: Measured facts: the candidate has 23 colours against 40 and 38 for the references, and a median of 9 colours per tile against 17 and 20. All of its dark edge pixels are neutral (100%), which matches the sticker-like near-black outline (#231d28, #283041). The references use tinted outlines (1% and 33% neutral). The roof has 3-4 steps with a stripe pattern and some highlights. The basin front is a flat gray with little grain, and the posts are flat orange with a single edge line. The piece is clearly thinner than both references.
